subject: Delta ledger opportunity cleanse & close-date alignment
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Delta ledger opportunity cleanse & close-date alignment

Team —

We've run the monthly Delta ledger snapshot and there are ~47 opportunities with either missing close dates or stage mismatches vs. our forecast rules. Finance asked for a quick hygiene pass so the Q2 forecast closes cleanly. Please do the following by EOD tomorrow (Wednesday):

- Owners: update Stage to one of (Discovery, Eval, Commit, Closed - Won/Lost). If unknown, move to "Qualification" and add a short note.
- Close date: if the close is beyond 90 days or unknown, set tentative date + add reason in the opportunity notes.
- Commit flag: ensure Commit = true only if a POC/POC sign-off or contract doc exists.

I've attached the CSV slice for your assigned accounts (see attachment). Call out any deals you want finance to exclude from the committed forecast and why.

Quick example of priority items I flagged:
- NIM-2027-Q2-09 (Nimbus Analytics) — stage says "Proposal" but no commercial contact on record; likely needs re-qual.
- NIM-2027-Q2-11 — close date set to 2027-07-30; finance wants realistic dates for quarter cutoffs.

Please reply with the HubSpot IDs you changed so I can reconcile. I'll run a post-cleanse pull and share the reconciliation with finance Thursday morning.

Thanks —
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Q2_pipeline_snapshot.csv (csv)]

Thanks for the quick responses.

Couple of follow-ups after a preliminary pass:
- Finance asked that we lock any changes before 11:59pm PDT Wednesday in the live forecast so they can freeze the numbers. Please only edit if you own the opp or have coordinated with the assigned rep.
- @Marissa — mark Commit=false for legal-blocked deals.
- @Laura — please triage the sync issue (HS-98765) and let us know if it's a platform sync or manual error; if sync, we may exclude it from the committed rollup.

I'll run the final reconciliation at 11:45pm and publish a short variance report to the finance Slack channel. If anyone needs more time, tell me now so I can flag exceptions.
